comments.text: Level 3 glyph pixels for character codes 0 through 127, eight rows per glyph. $CAA6 indexes this charset when testing a hull overlap.
Level 3 glyph pixels for character codes 128 through 255. The solid-character mask at $8024 uses these codes as well as those in the lower half.

The four level 3 mask banks at $5800, $5880, $5900 and $5980 each hold 128 bytes. $CAA6 selects a base from $11E6/$11EA and adds eight times the hull cell index before comparing with terrain glyph pixels.
Two empty hull-mask banks with all bits set. Their offsets are those of the mirrored hull masks in the other three overlays.
Level 3 CHARS payload tail. The loop at $C969 copies the entire page to $6F00 before level setup reuses these addresses. The file supplies 256 bytes of the page.
Level 3 header, the little-endian addresses $976D and $97AE of the low and high sprite offset tables. $CDB1 writes them into the operands at $DCA3 and $DCA8.
Level 3 scroll-direction sequence. Starts at 1, contains 21 entries of 1, 7 of 2 and 3 of 3, and ends in 0. The initial direction is read at $CC6A and subsequent entries at $9E28.

Level 3 solid-character mask. Index this 32-byte table with the character code shifted right 3, then test the bit from $1457 indexed by the low three bits. The shot and hull tests read it at $2FCF and $CA8E.
